name: robot-preview-usd
displayName: Robot Preview: USD Viewer (OpenUSD, Isaac Sim)
description: OpenUSD viewer for USD, USDA, USDC and USDZ inside VS Code: Isaac Sim robots, NuRec Gaussian splats and meshes, with a Stage tree and click-to-select prims

customEditors.displayName: Robot Preview: USD Viewer (OpenUSD, Isaac Sim)
Robot Preview: USD Viewer (OpenUSD, Isaac Sim)

scripts.build: node ../mesh-splat/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node -e "for (const file of ['extension.js', 'io.js']) require('fs').copyFileSync('../mesh-splat/' + file, 'dist/' + file)"
scripts.package: npm run build && npx --yes -p node@20 -p @vscode/vsce@3 vsce package --no-dependencies --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/chenyuting3077/robot-preview/raw/HEAD/packages/usd
scripts.publish:ovsx: npm run build && npx --yes -p node@20 -p ovsx@0.10.6 ovsx publish --no-dependencies --skip-duplicate --baseImagesUrl https://github.com/chenyuting3077/robot-preview/raw/HEAD/packages/usd
